claims.claim: Google DeepMind released Genie 4 in research preview, with mid-simulation text edits and native real-time audio.
claims.episode_span: Google DeepMind has released Genie 4 in research preview for trusted testers.
claims.source_title: Google DeepMind Releases Genie 4 World Model With Real-Time Editing and Audio
claims.supporting_quote: Google DeepMind has released Genie 4, its newest world model, in research preview.

claims.claim: Genie 4 maintains consistent scenes for up to two minutes, double Genie 3.
claims.episode_span: MarkTechPost reports scene consistency of up to two minutes, double Genie 3
claims.source_title: Google DeepMind Releases Genie 4 World Model With Real-Time Editing and Audio
claims.supporting_quote: Genie 4 maintains consistent scenes for up to two minutes, double that of Genie 3, with improved physics and more humanlike characters.

claims.claim: Genie 3 ran at 720p and 24 frames per second with visual memory of about one minute, and was announced in August 2025.
claims.episode_span: Genie 3, which it says ran at 720p and 24 frames per second with visual memory of about one minute after an August 2025 announcement
claims.source_title: Meet Google DeepMind’s Genie 4: Real-Time World Model With Native Audio
claims.supporting_quote: It succeeds Genie 3 , announced in August 2025. Genie 3 ran at 720p and 24 frames per second, with visual memory reaching back 1 minute.

claims.claim: Gemini 4 Argon split a checkers task into steps that Genie 4 simulated with Apptronik's Apollo humanoid.
claims.episode_span: Gemini 4 Argon split a checkers task into steps that Genie 4 simulated with Apptronik's Apollo humanoid
claims.source_title: Meet Google DeepMind’s Genie 4: Real-Time World Model With Native Audio
claims.supporting_quote: In one research demo, Gemini 4 Argon split a checkers task into steps. Genie 4 received each step as a text caption and simulated Apptronik’s Apollo humanoid playing the game.

claims.claim: Tejas Kulkarni said future world models will increasingly be hybrids.
claims.episode_span: Research director Tejas Kulkarni said future world models will be hybrids
claims.source_title: Google DeepMind Releases Genie 4 World Model With Real-Time Editing and Audio
claims.supporting_quote: Research director Tejas Kulkarni said future world models will increasingly be hybrids, with Gemini writing code and text and Genie simulating reality in real time.

claims.claim: All Genie 4 video and audio will carry SynthID watermarks, with access planned for Google AI Ultra subscribers and Gemini API partners.
claims.episode_span: All Genie 4 video and audio will carry SynthID watermarks
claims.source_title: Meet Google DeepMind’s Genie 4: Real-Time World Model With Native Audio
claims.supporting_quote: All Genie 4 video and audio will carry SynthID watermarks.

claims.claim: The new M6 iMac starts at $1,499, with pre-orders from October 28 and availability from November 6 in 35 countries and regions.

claims.source_title: Apple Unveils M6 iMac With Faster AI Performance, Starts at $1,499
claims.supporting_quote: Apple says the M6 processor delivers up to five times faster on-device AI performance than the previous M4-powered iMac.

claims.claim: The 12-core iMac starts at $1,699, with education prices of $1,449 and $1,599, and the M6 14-inch MacBook Pro starts at $1,999.

claims.supporting_quote: A higher configuration with a 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU starts at $1,699.
